mintAuthority.summary: DGLD is issued by Gold Token SA. On Ethereum the MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by a single issuer EOA that also owns the ProxyAdmin. After retiring the compromised Ethereum-Base bridge, the issuer deployed an independently gold-backed native Base token whose MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and ProxyAdmin owner are separately identified.

mintIncidents.summary: An exploit of the former Ethereum-Base bridge enabled unauthorized unbacked DGLD minting on Base. Gold Token SA retired that bridge, deployed a separately backed native Base token on June 30, and completed the legacy Base balance reset on July 15.

controls.evidence: Gold Token SA operates the issuance backend and can direct its chain-local MINTER_ROLE accounts to create DGLD against allocated PAMP gold bars. Neither native deployment has a contract-enforced aggregate supply ceiling, so the issuer backend can authorize unbounded expansion subject only to its off-chain backing policy.

upgradeability.controlRef: DGLD Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner — issuer EOA

review.evidence: Fresh reads at Ethereum block 25712296 and Base block 49713744 confirmed the two chain-local issuer EOAs still hold MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and their respective ProxyAdmin ownership. Both proxy paths remain immediate and neither implementation enforces an aggregate supply ceiling, so economic cap semantics are unbounded. The February 2026 bridge-mint incident remains resolved through bridge retirement and the replacement Base deployment. On 2026-08-08, Gold Token SA's live bar registry reconciled the displayed Ethereum and Base supplies to named PAMP bar serials with no displayed gap, supporting continuous issuer-operated reconciliation; this is self-reported rather than independent assurance. VQF AML self-regulatory membership is not prudential supervision.
